notes:
ARKhives 8.19.8 improves the desktop video lesson and document notebook workspace.

- Balanced view starts with 45% source and 55% notebook. Saved layouts, focus modes and divider positions remain personal to each source.
- Source headings, playback and capture actions stay compact while chapters, transcripts, document pages and the notebook scroll independently.
- Timestamp links, selected source passages and frame/page captures insert at the notebook cursor with source references.
- The notebook assistant explains, summarizes, compares or creates recall questions from selected text and the current source context. Suggestions appear in a preview before insertion.
- Choose the bundled ONLYOFFICE editor or Microsoft Word when installed on Windows. Word runs in a linked native window that follows the notebook area and preserves its own ribbon. It requires an existing licensed installation; it is not embedded in a browser frame.
- Both editors save the same canonical DOCX notebook through account-scoped local saves, revisions and draft recovery. Word source links return to the matching lesson timestamp or document page/section.
- Local source files and the learning engine remain unchanged. AI requests use the existing signed-in ARKhives connection. Lesson notebooks are desktop-only.
